_about: Settings for the App Map tools in this folder. Paths are relative to the repository root unless noted. sources: the app's UI source root. snapshots: the snapshot-test image folder ("" when there is none). watched: what check_drift diffs (default: sources and snapshots). ignored: path fragments of targets that are not on the map (previews, watch apps, test support). variantSnapshot: a regex for snapshot variants that are not drawn as their own board (large text, small phone; dark too unless the map draws dark copies). viewFileSuffixes and viewPattern: how check_drift recognises a view file. shared: shared UI path prefixes (design system, shared chrome); a change there flags every board that uses the changed type. board: the phone size in points. fonts: local font files that replace the Google Fonts link when rendering offline (file is a repo path). assets: the uploaded-image map, relative to the App Map folder.
